findings.evidence: `Mathlib/RingTheory/HopfAlgebra/Basic.lean:65` defines `HopfAlgebra` over `CommSemiring`, while `TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/FunctorOfPoints.lean:65-66` and `:108` construct the relevant convolution group under `[CommSemiring R]`; the new restriction originates at `PointsFunctor.lean:52` and `Hopf/InnerConjugation.lean:39`.
findings.fix: Generalize this file and the supporting `points`, `extendPoint`, `mapPoints`, and `pointsFunctor` declarations in `PointsFunctor.lean` to `[CommSemiring R]`; retain `CommRing` only for the coordinate-category layer if required there.
findings.issue: All pointwise inner-conjugation declarations require `[CommRing R]`, although their constructions and proofs only use the Hopf/convolution group API available over `[CommSemiring R]`.

summary: The pointwise conjugation API unnecessarily excludes commutative semiring bases.
